content: TOML in Go: no stdlib support (external only). BurntSushi/toml v1.6.0: reflection API mirroring encoding/json, TOML v1.1.0, ~5k stars, 38,240 importers, requires Go 1.19+; used by Trivy and aquasecurity/go-dep-parser for pyproject.toml. pelletier/go-toml/v2 v2.4.1: TOML v1.1.0, stdlib-like Unmarshal/Marshal with contextual DecodeError, 5-8x faster unmarshal than BurntSushi per its benchmarks, ~2k stars, used by Hugo; supports last two Go majors only. aquasecurity/go-dep-parser: per-format parsers keyed by manifest (golang/mod, nodejs/packagejson, python/pyproject, java/pom, php/composer, rust/cargo, nuget/packagesprops, gradle/lockfile), each implementing Parse(io.Reader) returning types.Library; repo note: 'Moved to the dependency package in Trivy' — standalone module is in maintenance, architecture is the reference for manifest-parser design, not a dependency to take.
